info.title: PD-Rehab-Web
info.description:
帕金森病智能辅助识别、运动状态量化与数字康复训练平台。

**医疗声明：** 本系统用于科研、辅助评估及康复训练展示，不能替代专业医生诊断和标准临床量表。

所有模型输出均来自真实模型；模型未配置时接口返回 `MODEL_NOT_CONFIGURED`，系统不会返回伪造结果。

get.description:
Authorized Web→Flutter snapshot, namespaced by original entity type.

Flutter saves this to a separate cache. These records MUST NOT be inserted
into its validated native practice.db tables: they use different formulas.

schema.title: Response Patient Data Api Integration V1 Patient Data Get

AssessmentSessionDetail.title: AssessmentSessionDetail
AssessmentSessionDetail.description: Session plus the child results attached to it.

DifficultyConfigSchema.title: DifficultyConfigSchema
DifficultyConfigSchema.description: The difficulty parameters actually used for a round.

ExerciseCueRead.title: ExerciseCueRead
ExerciseCueRead.description: One step of the counted phrase the patient follows.

LeftRightComparison.title: LeftRightComparison
LeftRightComparison.description:
Left/right summary for one session.

Computed in the result layer; never stored on a single-hand row.
`None` means one side is missing -- never substitute 0.

PatientListItem.title: PatientListItem
PatientListItem.description: Row shape for the patient list table.

PianoCalibrationRequest.title: PianoCalibrationRequest
PianoCalibrationRequest.description: Open a calibration round (30-60 s) used to set the personal baseline.

PianoCompleteRequest.title: PianoCompleteRequest
PianoCompleteRequest.description: Close the round and record the adaptation decision.

PianoEventIn.title: PianoEventIn
PianoEventIn.description:
One raw key event.

`cue_onset_time_ms` and `target_time_ms` are required because they are what
makes `response_latency_ms` and `timing_error_ms` interpretable; the backend
does not recompute them from wall-clock time.

PianoEventRead.title: PianoEventRead
PianoEventRead.description:
A raw event as returned to the frontend.

`is_wrong_key`, `cue_index` and the sequence fields are not dedicated DB
columns; they are persisted in the session's audit JSON and re-joined here so
the frontend can render wrong-key presses and replay a sequence exactly.

PianoEventsBatch.title: PianoEventsBatch
PianoEventsBatch.description:
Raw events for a round, posted in one batch.

Raw events are the primary record: they are stored before any summary metric
is considered, so the metrics can always be recomputed from them.

PianoRawPress.title: PianoRawPress
PianoRawPress.description:
Every captured press, including prompt-phase and extra input.

Times are relative to the round start, separate from scored cue rows.

PianoSessionCreate.title: PianoSessionCreate
PianoSessionCreate.description: Open a training round. Returns the configuration the frontend must use.

PoseAnalysisResponse.title: PoseAnalysisResponse
PoseAnalysisResponse.description:
Result of analysing one recording.

`accepted` is False when a quality gate refused the recording; the measured
metrics are still returned so the reason is visible, but the session is not
presented as a valid measurement.

PoseExerciseRead.title: PoseExerciseRead
PoseExerciseRead.description: One ballet exercise, with its metrics, cues and honest score availability.

PoseSessionCreate.title: PoseSessionCreate
PoseSessionCreate.description: Open a movement-training session for one exercise.

PoseThresholdsRead.title: PoseThresholdsRead
PoseThresholdsRead.description: The derivations behind the quality gates, so a refusal can be explained.

SpontaneousTapping.title: SpontaneousTapping
SpontaneousTapping.description:
The patient's own rhythm, measured with no cue present.

A measurement, not a task: nothing here is scored right or wrong. It is what
"110% of baseline tempo" is a percentage OF (see
docs/piano_training_plan.md P1).
